description: Unit tests for the RttStats class in the QUIC congestion control module, verifying RTT measurement, smoothing, min RTT, connection migration reset, and standard deviation calculations.

classes.name: RttStatsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for RTT statistics unit tests, inheriting from QuicTest.

methods.name: DefaultsBeforeUpdate
methods.description: Tests default RTT values before any updates.

methods.name: SmoothedRtt
methods.description: Verifies RTT smoothing behavior with various update scenarios.

methods.name: SmoothedRttStability
methods.description: Checks that smoothed RTT remains stable despite rounding artifacts.

methods.name: PreviousSmoothedRtt
methods.description: Ensures previous smoothed RTT is correctly tracked after updates.

methods.name: MinRtt
methods.description: Tests minimum RTT calculation over multiple updates.

methods.name: ExpireSmoothedMetrics
methods.description: Verifies behavior of smoothed RTT and deviation after expiration.

methods.name: UpdateRttWithBadSendDeltas
methods.description: Checks that invalid send deltas do not alter RTT stats.

methods.name: ResetAfterConnectionMigrations
methods.description: Ensures RTT stats reset correctly after connection migration.

methods.name: StandardDeviationCaculatorTest1
methods.description: Tests standard deviation calculation with identical samples.

methods.name: StandardDeviationCaculatorTest2
methods.description: Tests standard deviation with small variance in samples.

methods.name: StandardDeviationCaculatorTest3
methods.description: Tests standard deviation with some variance in samples.
